about: The veto override bar of each state and Puerto Rico whose legislature the game does not compile from its own instruments, read from each constitution on September 29, 2026 (Build 3, CTO ruling of 1:24 a.m.). Each row gives the fraction, the words the constitution uses for who counts, the section, the address read and a quote. Where the constitution says only "two-thirds of that house", the row counts members present, which is how those chambers take the vote; that mapping is the game's, and readBasis keeps the constitution's words. researchStatus says how the text was reached: most were read from the official page; Alabama, New Mexico and New York from a bill that reprints the section; Arkansas from its finance department's veto record; Wisconsin from its Legislative Reference Bureau; Georgia, Mississippi and New Hampshire, whose pages refused this connection, from a search engine's excerpt of the official text.

readings.name: Alabama
readings.readBasis: the whole number elected to that house
readings.locator: Section 125 (Constitution of Alabama of 2022), as reprinted in House Bill 48 of 2025
readings.quote: If a majority of the whole number elected to that house votes for the passage of the bill, the bill shall be sent with the objections

readings.name: Arkansas
readings.readBasis: the whole number elected to that house
readings.locator: Article 6, section 15, as quoted by the Department of Finance and Administration's veto record
readings.quote: If, after such reconsideration, a majority of the whole number elected to that house, shall agree to pass the bill, it shall be sent, with the objections, to the other house

readings.name: Arizona
readings.readBasis: the members elected to each house
readings.quote: If after reconsideration it again passes both houses by an aye and nay vote on roll call of two-thirds of the members elected to each house, it shall become a law

readings.name: California
readings.readBasis: the membership
readings.quote: If each house then passes the bill by rollcall vote entered in the journal, two-thirds of the membership concurring, it becomes a statute.

readings.name: Colorado
readings.readBasis: the members elected
readings.quote: If then two-thirds of the members elected agree to pass the same, it shall be sent, together with the objections, to the other house, by which it shall likewise be reconsidered, and if approved by two-thirds of the members elected to that house, it shall become a law

readings.name: Connecticut
readings.readBasis: its members
readings.quote: If, after such reconsideration, that house shall again pass it, but by the approval of at least two-thirds of its members, it shall be sent with the objections to the other house

readings.name: Delaware
readings.readBasis: all the members elected to that House
readings.quote: If, after such reconsideration, three-fifths of all the members elected to that House shall agree to pass the bill, it shall be sent together with the objections to the other House

readings.name: Florida
readings.readBasis: a two-thirds vote
readings.quote: If each house shall, by a two-thirds vote, re-enact the bill or reinstate the vetoed specific appropriation of a general appropriation bill, the vote of each member voting shall be entered on the respective journals

readings.name: Georgia
readings.readBasis: the members to which such house is entitled
readings.locator: Article III, Section V, Paragraph XIII
readings.quote: upon the vote to override the veto by two-thirds of the members to which such other house is entitled, such bill or resolution shall become law

readings.name: Hawaii
readings.readBasis: all members to which each house is entitled
readings.quote: If after such reconsideration such bill, or such item or items, shall be approved by a two-thirds vote of all members to which each house is entitled, the same shall become law.

readings.name: Iowa
readings.readBasis: the members of each house
readings.quote: if, after such re-consideration, it again pass both houses, by yeas and nays, by a majority of two thirds of the members of each house, it shall become a law, notwithstanding the Governor's objections.

readings.name: Idaho
readings.readBasis: the members present
readings.quote: If then two-thirds of the members present agree to pass the same, it shall be sent, together with the objections, to the other house

readings.name: Indiana
readings.readBasis: all the members elected to that House
readings.quote: If, after such reconsideration and vote, a majority of all the members elected to that House shall approve the bill, it shall be sent, with the Governor's objections, to the other House

readings.name: Kansas
readings.readBasis: the members then elected (or appointed) and qualified
readings.quote: If two-thirds of the members then elected (or appointed) and qualified shall vote to pass the bill, it shall be sent, with the veto message, to the other house

readings.name: Louisiana
readings.readBasis: the elected members of each house
readings.quote: A bill vetoed and returned and subsequently approved by two-thirds of the elected members of each house shall become law.

readings.name: Massachusetts
readings.readBasis: the said senate or house of representatives
readings.locator: Part the Second, Chapter I, Section I, Article II
readings.quote: But if after such reconsideration, two thirds of the said senate or house of representatives, shall, notwithstanding the said objections, agree to pass the same, it shall, together with the objections, be sent to the other branch of the legislature

readings.name: Maine
readings.readBasis: that House
readings.quote: If after such reconsideration, 2/3 of that House shall agree to pass it, it shall be sent together with the objections, to the other House, by which it shall be reconsidered, and, if approved by 2/3 of that House, it shall have the same effect as if it had been signed by the Governor

readings.name: Michigan
readings.readBasis: the members elected to and serving in that house
readings.quote: If two-thirds of the members elected to and serving in that house pass the bill notwithstanding the objections of the governor, it shall be sent with the objections to the other house for reconsideration.

readings.name: Mississippi
readings.readBasis: that House
readings.quote: If after such reconsideration two-thirds (2/3) of that House shall agree to pass the Bill, it shall be sent, with the objections, to the other House, by which, likewise, it shall be reconsidered; and if approved by two-thirds (2/3) of that House, it shall become a law

readings.name: Montana
readings.readBasis: the members of each house present
readings.quote: If after receipt of a veto message, two-thirds of the members of each house present approve the bill, it shall become law.

readings.name: North Dakota
readings.readBasis: the members elected to that house
readings.quote: If, by a recorded vote, two-thirds of the members elected to that house pass a vetoed item or bill, it, along with the statement of the governor's objections, must immediately be delivered to the other house.

readings.name: New Hampshire
readings.readBasis: that house
readings.quote: if after such reconsideration, two-thirds of that house shall agree to pass the bill, it shall be sent, together with such objections, to the other house, by which it shall likewise be reconsidered, and, if approved by two-thirds of that house, it shall become a law

readings.name: New Jersey
readings.readBasis: all the members of the house of origin
readings.quote: two-thirds of all the members of the house of origin agree to pass the bill, it shall be sent, together with the objections

readings.name: New Mexico
readings.readBasis: the members present and voting in each house
readings.quote: such bill shall not become a law unless thereafter approved by two-thirds of the members present and voting in each house by yea and nay vote entered upon its journal.

readings.name: New York
readings.readBasis: the members elected to that house
readings.quote: If after such reconsideration, two-thirds of the members elected to that house shall agree to pass the bill, it shall be sent together with the objections, to the other house, by which it shall likewise be reconsidered; and if approved by two-thirds of the members elected to that house, it shall become a law notwithstanding the objections of the governor.

readings.name: Oklahoma
readings.readBasis: the members elected to that house
readings.quote: If, after such reconsideration, two-thirds of the members elected to that house shall agree to pass the bill or joint resolution, it shall be sent, together with the objections

readings.name: Oregon
readings.readBasis: the members present
readings.quote: If, after such reconsideration, two-thirds of the members present shall agree to pass the bill, it shall be sent, together with the objections, to the other house, by which it shall likewise be reconsidered, and, if approved by two-thirds of the members present, it shall become a law.

readings.name: Pennsylvania
readings.readBasis: all the members elected to that House
readings.quote: If after such re-consideration, two-thirds of all the members elected to that House shall agree to pass the bill, it shall be sent with the objections to the other House by which likewise it shall be re-considered, and if approved by two-thirds of all the members elected to that House it shall be a law

readings.name: Puerto Rico
readings.readBasis: the total number of members of which each house is composed
readings.quote: When the Governor returns a bill the house that receives it shall enter his objections on its journal and both houses may reconsider it. If approved by two-thirds of the total number of members of which each house is composed, said bill shall become law.

readings.name: Rhode Island
readings.readBasis: the members present and voting in that house
readings.quote: If, after such reconsideration, three-fifths of the members present and voting in that house shall vote to pass the measure, it shall be sent with the objections, to the other house, by which it shall likewise be reconsidered, and if approved by three-fifths of the members present and voting

readings.name: South Carolina
readings.readBasis: that house
readings.quote: If after such reconsideration two-thirds of that house shall agree to pass it, it shall be sent, together with the objections, to the other house, by which it shall be reconsidered, and if approved by two-thirds of that house it shall have the same effect as if it had been signed by the Governor

readings.name: South Dakota
readings.readBasis: all members of each house
readings.quote: Any vetoed bill shall be reconsidered by the Legislature and, if two-thirds of all members of each house shall pass the bill, it shall become law.

readings.name: Texas
readings.readBasis: the members present
readings.quote: If after such reconsideration, two-thirds of the members present agree to pass the bill, it shall be sent, with the objections, to the other House, by which likewise it shall be reconsidered; and, if approved by two-thirds of the members of that House, it shall become a law

readings.name: Utah
readings.readBasis: the members elected to each house
readings.quote: If upon reconsideration the bill again passes both houses by a yea and nay vote of two-thirds of the members elected to each house, it shall become a law.

readings.name: Vermont
readings.readBasis: the members present of that House
readings.quote: If, upon such reconsideration, two-thirds of the members present of that House shall pass the bill, it shall, together with the objections, be sent to the other House, by which it shall likewise be reconsidered, and if approved by two-thirds of the members present of that House, it shall become a law.

readings.name: Washington
readings.readBasis: the members present
readings.quote: If, after such reconsideration, two-thirds of the members present shall agree to pass the bill it shall be sent, together with the objections, to the other house, by which it shall likewise be reconsidered, and if approved by two-thirds of the members present, it shall become a law

readings.name: Wisconsin
readings.readBasis: the members present
readings.locator: Article V, section 10 (as the Legislative Reference Bureau states it)
readings.quote: The house of origin may then reconsider the bill, and if two-thirds of the members present in that house "agree to pass the bill notwithstanding the objections of the governor," the bill is sent to the other house.

readings.name: Wyoming
readings.readBasis: the members elected
readings.quote: If, after such reconsideration, two-thirds of the members elected agree to pass the bill, it shall be sent, together with the objections, to the other house, by which it shall likewise be reconsidered, and if it be approved by two-thirds of the members elected, it shall become a law
